en: Critical lift: over {a}% — needs a written lift plan and sign-off.
Over {b}%: too close to the limit — replan (shorter radius, bigger crane, lighter rigging).
OVER THE CHART — this lift is not allowed.
Worked out on the phone — exact, instant, no model
The phone is hot — it slows the processor down on purpose. Let it cool, take it out of its case, don't charge while asking.
Battery saver is on — it caps the processor. Turn it off while using Attune.
Free memory is low for this model — close other apps (games, camera, many browser tabs).
The model is read from storage instead of RAM — update to the latest Attune APK (it loads the model into RAM).
The engine is using its slowest processor path (no dotprod). Send this report.
The phone is critically hot — Attune stops an answer in progress and keeps what was written. Let it cool for a few minutes.
The phone is very hot — Attune waits up to 20 seconds before each new answer so it can cool, and uses fewer threads the next time the model starts.
The phone is getting warm — long answers may slow down soon. Short breaks between answers keep it fast.
Only {n} threads are used for writing.
This is a big model for a phone — Qwen 3.5 4B is about 2–3× faster.
Nothing obvious — the phone may have slowed Attune while it was in the background. The new APK keeps it at full speed while writing.

The fast one. Runs on the phone's graphics chip: the first words appear in under a second and it writes faster than you can read. Reads photos, English and Arabic. For hard reasoning, the E4B below is stronger.
The stronger fast one: noticeably better answers than the E2B, still on the graphics chip — first words in about a second, then roughly 20–45 words a second on a flagship.
This model is large for this phone. It works, but answers come slowly and the phone gets warm. For quick answers use Gemma 4 E2B on the fast engine — reads photos, first words in about a second.
Fast engine on the graphics chip
On: the model runs on the GPU — first words in about a second. Off: the CPU, slower, only for phones whose GPU driver misbehaves.
Gemma 4 E2B on the graphics chip: first words in about a second, many times faster than this engine. {s} GB, once.
The fast engine is running on the CPU, not the graphics chip — turn on “Use the graphics chip” above. If it switched itself off, the phone's GPU driver refused it: send this report.
The biggest speed-up on this phone is the fast engine: Gemma 4 E2B on the graphics chip — first words in about a second. Tap “Switch to the fast engine” above.
The GPU would not start, so the fast engine is on the CPU.
Last time, starting the fast engine on the GPU closed the app. It is on the CPU now; you can try the GPU again in Engine → Speed.
Preparing the fast engine (the first start on the GPU takes longest)

A picture — Studio draws it on this phone
Current photo quality in 4 steps: people, places, products and text in pictures. Also edits a photo you give it (“make it night”, “remove the car”).
Describe the picture, in Arabic or English — e.g. “a felucca on the Nile at sunset”
Download it on Wi-Fi. After that, pictures are made with no internet at all.
Draw on the graphics chip (faster; switches itself off if the driver fails)
Drawing on the GPU failed, so Attune switched Studio to the CPU.
Each picture is made by a separate engine process: when it finishes, all its memory goes back to the phone. Nothing is uploaded.
Makes a finished picture four times bigger and sharper — for printing or zooming in.
Pick the photo to edit first.
Saving to the gallery needs Android 10 or newer — use Share instead.

This version of Attune has no graphics-chip picture engine, so pictures are drawn on the CPU (slower). An update adds it.
